summary: Fetch the evidence notes without the partial-clone filter so the gate's verifier does not read each note's blob over the network one at a time

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes; this changes the CI evidence gate's git fetch flags and a test.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes. Every check stays enforce false.

compatibility.detail: No command, frame, scope or stored-format change.

downtime.detail: No startup work or expected interruption.

recovery.detail: No persistent product state changes or new swap-back restrictions.
